fact: The party stands before a stone sarcophagus in the Lost Tomb of Khaem.
source_quote: The party stood before the stone sarcophagus of Brysis
subject: Lost Tomb of Khaem

fact: Brysis is a withered, mummified undead creature inside a stone sarcophagus.
source_quote: the withered, mummified remains within
subject: Brysis

fact: Zalthir uses his action to pry open the lid of Brysis's sarcophagus.
source_quote: Zalthir had spent his action opening it
subject: Sarcophagus opened

fact: Opening the sarcophagus prevents Brysis from hiding inside it.
source_quote: so that Brysis could no longer hide inside
subject: Brysis exposed

fact: A sentient sword rests atop Brysis's remains in the sarcophagus.
source_quote: Resting atop the ancient corpse was a sword
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Dawnbringer speaks and pleads to be rescued from her imprisonment.
source_quote: pleading desperately to be rescued from its long imprisonment: "You can't leave me here. Please."
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Gyrgum wishes the sword had been a less squeaky talking mace.
source_quote: Gyrgum groaned at yet another talking magic sword and wished she had been a less squeaky talking mace
subject: Zalthir and Gyrgum dialogue

fact: Zalthir tells the sword she could have been a glove since he is a monk.
source_quote: Zalthir, a monk with no use for bladed weapons, said she could at least have been a glove
subject: Zalthir and Dawnbringer dialogue

fact: Dawnbringer demands Zalthir bring the fighter to her.
source_quote: she demanded, "wait, you're a monk. Get the fighter over here."
subject: Dawnbringer and Zalthir dialogue

fact: The battle against Brysis is fought in a shroud of magical darkness.
source_quote: fought largely in a shroud of magical darkness that blinded friend and foe alike
subject: Combat darkness

fact: Zalthir moves his orb of darkness over Thorin.
source_quote: Zalthir moved his orb of darkness over Thorin
subject: Zalthir moves darkness

fact: Zalthir spends focus points to strike twice with advantage from inside the darkness.
source_quote: spent focus points to strike twice with advantage from inside it
subject: Zalthir attacks

fact: Gyrgum saves his last Turn Undead use as a potential escape option.
source_quote: He held back on the GM's advice, saving his last use in case the party needed a quick getaway
subject: Gyrgum prepares turn undead

fact: Gyrgum decides not to cast Guiding Bolt because it would be at disadvantage.
source_quote: He also passed on Guiding Bolt, which would have fired blind at disadvantage
subject: Gyrgum passes on Guiding Bolt

fact: Gyrgum casts Tasha's Caustic Brew as a five-foot-wide stream past Zalthir.
source_quote: threaded a five-foot stream of Tasha's Caustic Brew past Zalthir
subject: Gyrgum casts Tasha's Caustic Brew

fact: Brysis fails her saving throw against Tasha's Caustic Brew.
source_quote: Brysis blew the saving throw
subject: Brysis

fact: Acid clings to Brysis and causes ongoing damage.
source_quote: acid clung to her and kept eating away at her
subject: Acid damage

fact: Daz fires three scorching rays into the darkness at Brysis.
source_quote: Daz, unable to see his target, fired three scorching rays into the darkness anyway
subject: Daz casts Scorching Ray

fact: Two of Daz's rays hit for 10 damage each and one for 3 damage.
source_quote: Two hit for 10 each and one for 3, a total of 23
subject: Scorching Ray hits

fact: Brysis rages that she will not be defeated after a millennium of imprisonment.
source_quote: Brysis raged that she would not be defeated after a millennium of imprisonment
subject: Brysis speaks

fact: Daz retreats up the tunnel to avoid being turned into a specter by Brysis.
source_quote: Daz retreated up the tunnel so the creature could not turn him into a specter out of revenge
subject: Daz retreats

fact: Daz is currently down 12 maximum hit points.
source_quote: He is already down 12 maximum hit points
subject: Daz

fact: Brysis is destroyed by the lingering acid before she can retaliate.
source_quote: Brysis was resistant to acid, but she had only three hit points left, and she was destroyed before she could make good on his threat
subject: Brysis destroyed

fact: Brysis is destroyed, ending the battle.
source_quote: she was destroyed before she could make good on his threat
subject: Brysis

fact: Thorin reaches into the sarcophagus and pulls free the sentient sword.
source_quote: he reached into the sarcophagus and pulled free the sentient sword
subject: Thorin grabs sword

fact: When Thorin grasps her hilt, Dawnbringer ignites into a blade of pure radiance.
source_quote: The moment he grasped the hilt, a blade of pure radiance blazed to life
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Dawnbringer identifies herself as a legendary sword.
source_quote: The sword announced herself with "Dawnbringer here! Let me show you what I can do!"
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Dawnbringer deals radiant damage instead of slashing damage.
source_quote: deals radiant damage instead of slashing
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Dawnbringer adds 1d8 damage against undead.
source_quote: adds 1d8 against undead
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Dawnbringer grants the lesser restoration effect.
source_quote: grants lesser restoration
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Igniting Dawnbringer's blade costs a bonus action.
source_quote: igniting the blade costs a bonus action
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Brysis speaks her final words to Dawnbringer before being destroyed.
source_quote: Brysis managed only "not done, Dawnbringer."
subject: Brysis

fact: Dawnbringer is able to read.
source_quote: She could even read
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Gyrgum marvels that the sword can read.
source_quote: Gyrgum to marvel, "Wow, a sword that can read."
subject: Gyrgum and Dawnbringer dialogue

fact: Dawnbringer responds to Gyrgum's comment with a pointed "seriously?"
source_quote: The sword's response was a pointed "seriously?"
subject: Dawnbringer response
